chunks.title: About Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara
chunks.heading: About the campus
chunks.text:
Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara (known as YSPM's YTC) is run by the Yashoda Shikshan Prasarak Mandal (YSPM). The trust laid its foundation in the year 2009, so the campus carries a legacy of more than sixteen years of academic excellence. The campus is recognized by the Government of Maharashtra and approved by AICTE, New Delhi.
Yashoda Technical Campus has been conferred Autonomous Status by the University Grants Commission (UGC), India. The campus is accredited by NAAC with a 'B+' grade, and key programmes hold NBA accreditation.

Scale of the campus — The campus is home to more than 5,000 students guided by over 200 staff members. The institute has built more than 300 industry connects and a global alumni family of over 50,000. Over the years the campus has received more than 30 awards, including honours such as the Lokmat Global Excellence Award.

Affiliations and approvals at Yashoda — Programmes at Yashoda run under different affiliating bodies depending on the faculty:
- B.Tech, M.Tech, B.Pharmacy, M.Pharmacy and Pharm D are affiliated to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU), Lonere.
- MBA and MCA are affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur.
- Diploma in Engineering (Polytechnic) and D.Pharmacy are affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education (MSBTE), Mumbai.
- Pharmacy programmes are approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi, and all technical programmes by AICTE and the Directorate of Technical Education (DTE), Maharashtra.

Faculties at Yashoda Technical Campus — The campus houses the Faculty of Engineering, Faculty of Polytechnic, Faculty of Pharmacy, Faculty of MBA, Faculty of MCA, Faculty of BBA and Faculty of BCA. The Yashoda group also runs the Yashoda College of Architecture, Satara (ycoa.org.in) and the Yashoda College of Pharmacy (ycop.edu.in) as sister institutes.

Campus environment — The campus describes itself as a green, clean and healthy campus. Facilities include well-equipped laboratories, a central library with digital resources, spacious smart classrooms, a central computer centre with high-speed internet, a large auditorium, canteen with hygienic food, RO drinking water, sports grounds, a gymkhana, and guest and expert lectures by eminent personalities. Students benefit from industrial tours and visits, campus interviews, and a dedicated training and placement cell.

chunks.title: Admission Process at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: How admission works at Yashoda
chunks.text:
Here is how admission works at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara. Most seats are filled through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) conducted by the Maharashtra State Common Entrance Test Cell. The complete CAP schedule, rounds and merit lists are published on the CET Cell website (cetcell.mahacet.org) and on dtemaharashtra.gov.in. The campus admission office updates its own admission notices on yes.edu.in during the admission season.
The entrance route depends on the programme:
- B.Tech and M.Tech: through CAP after MHT-CET (and applicable national entrance scores as per State CET Cell rules for the year).
- MBA and MCA: through CAP after the MAH-MBA/MMS-CET and MAH-MCA-CET respectively.
- B.Pharmacy, Pharm D and D.Pharmacy: as per the CET Cell and PCI norms published for the year.
- Diploma in Engineering (Polytechnic): after SSC through the centralised admission process for first-year diploma.

Institute-level and vacant seats at Yashoda — After the CAP rounds, institute-level seats and seats remaining vacant after CAP are filled by the campus admission office at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara, as per the rules published for that admission year. Parents and students can contact the admission office directly about institute-level admission in any faculty — Engineering, Polytechnic, Pharmacy, MBA or MCA. The office can tell you which branches still have vacant seats, what the merit position needs to look like, and how the institute-level round is scheduled. Many Satara-district families take this route after the CAP rounds close, so it is worth calling the office early rather than waiting.

chunks.title: Admission Process at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: Eligibility for each programme at Yashoda (पात्रता)
chunks.text:
How does eligibility (पात्रता, eligibility criteria) work at Yashoda? The affiliating body and the Maharashtra State CET Cell decide the exact criteria for every admission year, and cut-offs change from year to year — so the office always confirms the numbers rather than quoting old ones. As a general guide:
- B.Tech first year: HSC (12th) Science with Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, through the CET Cell CAP process
- B.Tech direct second year: a recognised engineering diploma in a relevant branch
- B.Pharmacy and Pharm D: HSC Science as per PCI and CET Cell norms
- D.Pharmacy and Polytechnic diploma: SSC (10th) as per the centralised process
- M.Tech: a relevant B.E./B.Tech degree; M.Pharmacy: B.Pharmacy; MBA: any recognised graduation through MAH-MBA/MMS-CET; MCA: graduation with the required mathematics/computer background through MAH-MCA-CET
Category, home-university and minority candidature types follow the rules published by the CET Cell for the year. The admission office at Yashoda checks your exact eligibility, category and documents before you apply, so the safest next step is a phone call or a campus visit with your marksheets.

chunks.title: Admission Process at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: Documents to keep ready for admission at Yashoda
chunks.text:
Keep the originals and a few photocopies ready before CAP reporting or institute-level admission. Commonly required documents are:
- SSC (10th) marksheet and HSC (12th) marksheet, or diploma marksheets for direct second-year and post-graduate entry
- Entrance exam scorecard (MHT-CET, MAH-MBA-CET, MAH-MCA-CET or as applicable)
- School or college leaving certificate / transfer certificate
- Domicile certificate and nationality proof as per state rules
- Caste certificate and caste validity certificate, where applicable
- Non-creamy layer certificate, where applicable
- Income certificate for scholarship, EBC or TFWS benefits, where applicable
- Aadhaar card, passport-size photographs, and gap affidavit if there is a study gap
The admission office at Yashoda confirms the final list for your programme and category.

After admission — Once a seat is allotted and confirmed, students complete enrolment at the campus at Wadhe, Satara. Fee payment can be made online through the institute's payment portal, and hostel admission is done separately through the campus hostel office. Orientation and induction programmes (such as the Arambh induction programme) welcome new students at the start of the academic year.

chunks.title: Contact Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara
chunks.heading: Contacting the admission office
chunks.text:
The admission office at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara can be reached on phone and WhatsApp at +91 91722 20775, and by email at yspmadmin@yes.edu.in. Parents and students are welcome to call for any admission query — courses, intake, eligibility confirmation, fees (FRA-approved), hostel seats, bus routes or scholarship paperwork. The campus also runs an enquiry WhatsApp line on the same number listed on its website.

Address and location — YSPM's Yashoda Technical Campus, Wadhe, on National Highway 4 (NH-4), Satara, Maharashtra. The campus is about 8–9 km from the Satara bus stand on the Pune side of the city. Visitors coming from Pune, Karad, Kolhapur or Sangli can follow NH-4 directly to the Wadhe campus.

Useful official links — - Main website: yes.edu.in
- Faculty of Engineering: engg.yes.edu.in (courses, fee structures, hostel admissions, admission brochure and notices)
- Faculty of Pharmacy: pharma.yes.edu.in
- Faculty of Polytechnic: poly.yes.edu.in
- Faculty of MBA: mba.yes.edu.in
- Faculty of MCA: mca.yes.edu.in
- FRA-approved fee pages: yes.edu.in/fra-fee-approved and yes.edu.in/fee-proposals
- Online fee payment portal: the institute's secure payment link on easebuzz (linked from yes.edu.in)
- Scholarships: mahadbtmahait.gov.in and scholarships.gov.in
- CET Cell admissions: cetcell.mahacet.org and dtemaharashtra.gov.in
- Student grievance portal: grievance.yes.edu.in, and the national anti-ragging portal antiragging.in
- Social media: Facebook (yss.satra), Instagram (@yashodainstitutes), YouTube (@yspm2015), LinkedIn (yashoda-institutes) and the campus Telegram channel

Office hours and campus visits — Families visiting Satara are welcome to see the campus at Wadhe — the admission office can arrange a campus tour covering laboratories, the library, hostels and the canteen. Calling ahead on +91 91722 20775 to fix a time is recommended, especially on weekends and during the CAP admission season.

chunks.title: Faculty of Engineering — B.Tech and M.Tech Courses and Intake
chunks.heading: B.Tech courses and intake at Yashoda Faculty of Engineering
chunks.text:
The Faculty of Engineering at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara offers Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) programmes affiliated to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU), Lonere. Current programmes, with their sanctioned intake and start year, are:
- Computer Science and Engineering — intake 180, started 2011, NAAC and NBA accredited, choice code 675724210
- Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering — intake 120, started 2011, choice code 675737210
- Artificial Intelligence and Data Science — intake 120, started 2022, choice code 675799510
- Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security) — intake 120, started 2024, choice code 675726010
- Robotics and Artificial Intelligence — intake 60, started 2024, choice code 675726610
- Cloud Computing — intake 60, started 2026, choice code 675762410
- Civil and Environmental Engineering (institute-level) — intake 60, started 2026, choice code 675762410
- Electrical Engineering — intake 60, started 2011, NAAC and NBA accredited, choice code 675729310
- Civil Engineering — intake 30, started 2011, choice code 675719110
- Mechanical Engineering — intake 30, started 2011, choice code 675761210
- Mechatronics Engineering — intake 30, started 2024, choice code 675762410
Computer Science and Engineering at Yashoda has the largest intake, while the newer AI, data science, cyber security, robotics and cloud programmes reflect the campus focus on emerging technology. The institute's autonomous curriculum is designed with industry input, and initiatives such as the Microchip Centre of Excellence, E-Plan Centre of Excellence and the Electric Vehicle laboratory give students hands-on exposure.

M.Tech courses and intake — The Faculty of Engineering also offers Master of Technology (M.Tech) programmes affiliated to DBATU, Lonere:
- Mechanical Engineering — intake 12, started 2017
- Computer Science and Engineering — intake 18, started 2024
- Electric Vehicle Technology — intake 18, started 2026

Departments and learning environment — Engineering students learn in well-equipped laboratories and smart classrooms, supported by the central library, central computer centre and high-speed internet on campus. The engineering departments run industrial tours, expert guest lectures and project competitions — students have participated in district-level events such as the Inspire Award project exhibition in Satara. Eligible diploma holders can seek direct second-year admission to B.Tech through the same centralised process.

chunks.title: Fees and Scholarships at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: Fees at Yashoda — always check the official fee page
chunks.text:
Fees at Yashoda Technical Campus are approved by the Fees Regulating Authority (FRA), Government of Maharashtra, and differ by programme and admission year. The campus publishes its FRA-approved fee structures on its website — the FRA fee pages at yes.edu.in (FRA Fee Approved and Fee Proposals) and the engineering fee structure page at engg.yes.edu.in/engineering-fee-structures. Hostel fees, which include meals and accommodation, are published separately by the hostel office.
Because fees change year to year, the assistant never quotes fee amounts. The right next step is always to open the official fee page or ask the admission office to share the current FRA-approved structure for your programme. Fee payment can be completed online through the institute's secure payment portal, and there is a published fee refund policy on the website.

chunks.title: Fees and Scholarships at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: Scholarships as per Government norms
chunks.text:
Scholarships at Yashoda are available as per Government of Maharashtra and Government of India norms. The campus guides students through the applications. Schemes commonly used by Yashoda students include:
- Post-matric scholarships and freeships for SC, ST, OBC, VJNT and SBC category students through the MahaDBT portal (mahadbtmahait.gov.in)
- EBC (Economically Backward Class) fee concession — the Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj scheme — for eligible families through MahaDBT
- Tuition Fee Waiver Scheme (TFWS) seats allotted during CAP rounds for eligible students
- Minority and national scholarships through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Scholarship applications need supporting documents — caste and caste validity certificates, income certificate, domicile and bank details — so families are advised to keep these ready early. The admission office and the scholarship desk at the campus help students file applications correctly and on time.

chunks.title: Hostel and Transport at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara
chunks.heading: Hostels at Yashoda
chunks.text:
Yashoda Technical Campus provides hostel accommodation for girls and boys inside the green campus at Wadhe, Satara. The girls hostel is a safe and secure accommodation within the campus with a total intake capacity of 350; the boys hostel has a total intake capacity of 100. Hostel admission is done separately through the campus hostel office after admission to the course is confirmed.
Hostel facilities include a spacious and clean dining hall for hostellers, hygienic mess food, RO drinking water, first-aid facilities in each hostel, and access to the canteen, sports grounds and gymkhana. The hostel fee includes meals and accommodation; the current year's amounts are published by the hostel office, so please confirm the figure directly rather than relying on old numbers.

Bus and transport facility — The campus runs a bus facility for students from across Satara district. The college website lists the bus facility from Satara district among its key facilities, and buses connect surrounding towns to the campus. Route and timing details for the current year are confirmed by the transport office at the time of admission.

chunks.title: Hostel and Transport at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara
chunks.heading: Where the campus is and how to reach it
chunks.text:
Yashoda Technical Campus is located at Wadhe on National Highway 4 (NH-4, the Pune–Bengaluru highway), about 8 to 9 kilometres from the Satara bus stand on the Pune side. Typical travel times: from Pune about 110 km (2.5 to 3 hours by road); from Karad about 50 km (45 minutes); from Kolhapur about 130 km and Sangli about 120 km (about 2.5 hours); from Mumbai about 260 km (5 to 6 hours via the Mumbai–Pune Expressway and NH-4). The nearest airport is Pune International Airport (PNQ). MSRTC buses connect Satara with all major Maharashtra cities, and autos and cabs run from the Satara bus stand to the campus in 15 to 20 minutes.

Campus life around the hostel — Life around the hostel is active: canteen, RO water and dining hall for daily needs; library and computer centre for study; sports infrastructure and gymkhana for recreation; auditorium events, cultural programmes and NSS activities through the year. The campus positions itself as a green, clean and healthy campus, and the girls hostel sits within the campus boundary for safety and convenience.

chunks.title: MBA, MCA, BBA and BCA at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: MBA at Yashoda
chunks.text:
The Faculty of MBA at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara offers the Master of Business Administration (MBA), affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur. The programme is approved by AICTE, New Delhi and the Government of Maharashtra (DTE Mumbai), runs with an intake of 120 students, and began in 2011. Admission is through the MAH-MBA/MMS-CET followed by the centralised CAP rounds. The faculty runs professional development initiatives such as the T360 programme for students.

MCA at Yashoda — The Faculty of MCA offers the Master in Computer Application (MCA), affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur, accredited by NAAC and NBA, with an intake of 180 students since 2011. Admission is through the MAH-MCA-CET and the CAP process. MCA students work in the central computer centre with high-speed internet and modern computing setups.

BBA and BCA at Yashoda — The campus also houses the Faculty of BBA and the Faculty of BCA (undergraduate programmes affiliated to Shivaji University, Kolhapur), with their own admission offices reachable through bba.yes.edu.in and bca.yes.edu.in. Families interested in undergraduate management or computer applications after 12th can ask the admission office about seats in these faculties.

Architecture — a sister institute — The Yashoda group runs the Yashoda College of Architecture, Satara, as a separate institute on ycoa.org.in. Architecture admissions follow the NATA-based centralised process, and the college holds its own induction programmes on the group's campus in Satara. Questions about architecture admission are best confirmed with the architecture college office directly.

chunks.title: Faculty of Pharmacy — D.Pharm, B.Pharm, M.Pharm and Pharm D
chunks.heading: Pharmacy courses and intake at Yashoda Faculty of Pharmacy
chunks.text:
The Faculty of Pharmacy at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara is approved by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI), New Delhi and AICTE. It offers the full ladder of pharmacy education:
- Diploma in Pharmacy (D.Pharmacy) — affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education (MSBTE), Mumbai, intake 60, started 2011, NBA accredited, choice code 675782310
- Bachelor of Pharmacy (B.Pharmacy) — affiliated to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University (DBATU), Lonere, intake 100 plus 100, started 2011, NAAC accredited, choice code 675782310
- Pharm D — intake 30, started 2024, NAAC accredited, choice code 675710010

M.Pharm specializations — Master of Pharmacy (M.Pharmacy) programmes are affiliated to DBATU, Lonere, with four specializations:
- Pharmaceutics — intake 15, started 2011
- Pharmacology — intake 9, started 2011
- Pharmaceutical Chemistry — intake 15, started 2024
- Regulatory Affairs — intake 15, started 2024

Careers after pharmacy at Yashoda — Pharmacy graduates from the campus move into pharmaceutical industry roles, regulatory affairs, hospital and clinical pharmacy through the Pharm D route, and academia. Several alumni serve as assistant professors at pharmacy colleges — including the campus's own Faculty of Pharmacy. The Yashoda group also runs the Yashoda College of Pharmacy (ycop.edu.in) as a sister institute. The training and placement cell supports campus interviews and industrial exposure for pharmacy students.

chunks.title: Training and Placements at Yashoda Technical Campus
chunks.heading: How placements work at Yashoda
chunks.text:
Placement support at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara runs through a dedicated Training and Placement Cell. The cell arranges campus interviews, training sessions, industrial tours and visits, and guest lectures by eminent personalities, so students meet industry well before graduation. The campus reports 300+ industry connects.
Figures published on the campus website include 105 companies visiting the campus and 2,033 total students placed, with a highest package of 22 LPA and an average package of 4 LPA. These are the campus's published numbers for the years it reports; placement outcomes vary by programme, year and the student's own performance.

Recruiters and recent outcomes — Companies named in the campus's placement records include Capgemini, Atos, Byju's, Thermax, BASIC FIRST, Burns McDonnell, GaragePlug and Sandesh Solar & Electricals (Umbraj), among others visiting for campus drives. Pharmacy graduates have also moved into academia as assistant professors at pharmacy colleges, including the campus's own Faculty of Pharmacy. The campus has signed an MoA with the University of Jember, Indonesia for international academic cooperation, and has inaugurated industry-facing facilities such as the Microchip Centre of Excellence, E-Plan Centre of Excellence and the Electric Vehicle laboratory, which strengthen practical, placement-oriented learning.

What students should know — The placement cell supports students with campus interviews, aptitude and soft-skill preparation and industry exposure — but no honest institution can promise a job to every student. Families are welcome to ask the placement cell for the latest year's placement summary when they visit the campus or speak to the admission office.

chunks.title: Faculty of Polytechnic — Diploma Courses and Intake
chunks.heading: Diploma (Polytechnic) courses and intake at Yashoda
chunks.text:
The Faculty of Polytechnic at Yashoda Technical Campus, Satara offers Diploma in Engineering programmes affiliated to the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education (MSBTE), Mumbai. These three-year diploma programmes are open to students after SSC (10th standard) and give a direct route into technical careers or direct second-year B.Tech admission later. The polytechnic programmes, with intake and start year, are:
- Computer Engineering — intake 90, started 2022, choice code 675724510
- Civil Engineering — intake 60, started 2013, choice code 675719110
- Mechanical Engineering — intake 60, started 2013, choice code 675761210
- Electrical Engineering — intake 60, started 2014, choice code 675729310
- Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering — intake 60, started 2025, choice code 675737210
- Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning — intake 60, started 2023, choice code 675799810
- Automation and Robotics — intake 60, started 2026
- Instrumentation and Control Engineering — intake 60, started 2026

Why students from Satara district choose Yashoda polytechnic — For families across Satara district, the polytechnic at Yashoda offers a practical path: admission after 10th, hands-on laboratory work from the first year, MSBTE board examinations, and the same green campus facilities — library, computer centre, hostels, bus facility and canteen — as the degree students. The Faculty of Polytechnic runs its own induction programme (Arambh) for new diploma students, and diploma holders can progress to direct second-year B.Tech admission at the campus itself.
